title: Paving Reconstruction Project
description: Use this service request to inquire about the status of an alley, street, or thoroughfare reconstruction project being performed by the city or for complaints regarding a city reconstruction project taking place. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 8 business days. *** City projects have an 'informational' sign in the project area detailing the project ***

observedQuestions.prompt: Is your request regarding a routine street repair maintenance?

branches.No: Ask if street or alley is currently under reconstruction
branches.Yes: New Service Type Suggestion popup displayed current service type only

observedQuestions.prompt: Is this street/alley currently under reconstruction?

branches.Yes: Ask project type and concern description
branches.No: Validation Alert: do not continue; request is for current City of Dallas construction; utility or other contractor should use Construction Status Inquiry/Status

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about an ongoing City alley, street, or thoroughfare reconstruction project.
actions.why: For a status inquiry or complaint about an alley, street, or thoroughfare reconstruction project currently being performed by the City of Dallas. The description says City projects have an informational sign in the work area; the 311 request form asks whether the project is underway, the project type, and the concern.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Paving Reconstruction Project" requests does not apply to a location that is not currently under City reconstruction. If a utility or other contractor is doing the work, then consult the Dallas 311 website guidance for "Construction Status Inquiry/Status".
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Paving Reconstruction Project"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Paving Reconstruction Project"
